top_signals.title: Tetris distances itself from controversial White House ‘arcade’ games
top_signals.summary: Tetris said it did not give permission for the White House to use the game's iconic imagery for a controversial online arcade that was released Thursday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
